cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: The code constructs a shell command by substituting user-controlled URL into browser command template via path.replace("%u", href), then executes via os.execv("/bin/sh", ["/bin/sh", "-c", path])

connection.evidence: User-provided URL flows from _goto parameter through _fork call to command template substitution and shell execution. The path contains browser["path"] from configuration with %u placeholder replaced by URL.

diff_causality.evidence: This line initiates the _fork call that leads to shell command construction. Reverting would prevent URL substitution into browser command template.

security_control.evidence: No URL sanitization or validation before shell command construction; only basic encoder() function applied after substitution
security_control.required_control: Proper input validation and shell argument escaping
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-74 requires neutralization of special shell metacharacters when constructing shell commands from untrusted input
security_control.deficiency_evidence: URL is substituted directly into command template without validation; encoder() may not handle all shell metacharacters effectively

concrete_impact.evidence: Arbitrary command execution if URL contains shell metacharacters; demonstrated path shows direct shell execution with substituted content

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the _fork call would not execute, preventing URL substitution into browser command template and subsequent shell execution.
supporting_evidence: Line 142: path = path.replace("%u", href) - direct substitution of URL into command template
Line 145: os.execv("/bin/sh", ["/bin/sh", "-c", path]) - execution via shell interpreter
Line 273: url parameter passed to _fork from user-controlled navigation input
unresolved_facts: Exact implementation of encoder() function and its effectiveness against shell injection
Whether browser configuration path validation prevents command injection vectors
review_comment: User-provided URLs are directly substituted into browser command templates and executed via shell without proper validation. The URL replaces %u placeholder in browser["path"] configuration, then the entire command string is passed to /bin/sh -c. Use shlex.quote() on the URL before substitution or pass URL as separate argument to avoid shell interpretation.
